entities.name: Query ANAT1-like protein
observations: 418 aa sequence; sequence-based estimates: 47.6 kDa, pI 9.68, predicted positive charge at pH 7.
Strong-homology assignment: 85.3% identity and 100% coverage to reviewed Xenopus laevis alpha-tubulin N-acetyltransferase 1 (UniProt Q5FWM1).
Pfam Acetyltransf_16 domain detected at residues 3–211 (i-Evalue 3.2e-81).
Likely alpha-tubulin Lys40 acetyltransferase (EC 2.3.1.108), using acetyl-CoA; inferred from homolog annotations, not a direct assay of this query.
